title: custodian linkage record v1
description: Why declarations are bound together: the kind, the reason, the declarations bound. Checked against the code each time it is read.

name.description: The record's name: its file's name, the name an anchor carries.

kind.description: Why the declarations are bound (the linkage kinds table in custodian_kit's README).
enumDescriptions: a module uses another crate or module because that one owns the responsibility
an implementation depends on an invariant another declaration keeps
two types are connected for an architectural reason
a feature or a shape exists to satisfy a compatibility requirement
the declarations must stay synchronized with each other
a declaration must not be changed without considering the others
a dependency must not be replaced casually: its semantics are required

why.description: The reason, in the author's words.

binds.description: A declaration bound: an item path, a crate:/decl: route, or dep:<crate>. Repeats: one value per line, in order.

evidence.description: A bound file as it was when recorded: <path>=<sha256 hex>. Repeats: one value per line, in order.
